description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase.

Senior Software Engineer, (Coinbase One)

We’re hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join the Coinbase One product team within the Consumer Product Group. Coinbase One is Coinbase’s membership product, offering a suite of benefits for a recurring subscription fee to help customers get more from Coinbase. You’ll own customer-facing experiences and the frontend capabilities behind them, making it easier for customers to sign up, discover relevant benefits, and use their membership.

What you’ll do

  • Own frontend development for Coinbase One experiences in the Coinbase retail application, including sign-up flows, subscription payment experiences, targeted benefits, and special promotions and incentives.
  • Build reusable frontend components and platform capabilities that enable the team to launch and maintain membership features.
  • Lead projects from technical design through implementation, testing, and launch, breaking complex work into milestones and communicating risks and tradeoffs.
  • Partner with product managers, designers, and backend engineers to translate customer needs into reliable, intuitive user experiences.
  • Improve frontend performance, reliability, and maintainability through automated testing, production debugging, and ongoing improvements informed by customer and product feedback.
  • Mentor engineers through code reviews, technical guidance, and documentation, helping the team deliver high-quality software consistently.

Required skills and experience

  • Experience designing, building, and shipping production frontend applications using JavaScript, TypeScript, and React.
  • Experience integrating GraphQL APIs and writing automated unit tests for customer-facing features.
  • A track record of independently delivering complex software projects, making technical tradeoffs, and maintaining software after launch.
  • Experience building reusable components and improving application performance, reliability, and code quality.
  • Ability to collaborate across engineering, product, and design, clearly communicate technical decisions, and mentor other engineers.
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

 

Pay Transparency Notice: Base salary varies by location (see range below). Total compensation may also include equity and bonus eligibility, and benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k)). 

 

Annual base salary range (excluding equity and bonus):
$186,065—$218,900 USD
  • Application Limit: Candidates may submit a maximum of 3 applications within a 6-month period.
  • Equal Opportunity Employer: Coinbase is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information. Applicants with criminal histories will be considered consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
  • US Applicants: View Employee Rights, Know Your Rights, and E-Verify Notice of Participation.
  • Accommodations: If you are an individual with a disability who needs a reasonable accommodation, email us your request and contact info at accommodations[at]coinbase.com. Need screen reading technology? Click here to download a free compatible screen reader and view the tutorial.
  • Data Privacy & Arbitration: By submitting your application, you agree to our Candidate Privacy Notice. US applicants: By submitting your application, you agree to Arbitration of Disputes.
